methodology.hypothesis: The sector satellite should express relative equity leadership rather than permanently carry semiconductor exposure. Reallocate only its existing stock budget to the broad equity benchmark when the sector no longer leads. This retains equity participation instead of adding another cash risk gate and does not assume sector switching creates independent alpha.
methodology.winner: At each original fully informed month end, retain the source SOXX satellite budget only when its126session adjusted return strictly exceeds SPY over that exact horizon. Equality routes all of that budget to SPY. The126session horizon and strict comparison are inherited; this adapts the old return-winner principle to equity leadership,not its gold/Treasury selection or risk-budget computation.
methodology.votes: At the same source dates, retain the satellite budget times the fraction of63/126/252session SOXX adjusted returns strictly exceeding SPY on identical horizons. Three fixed equal signs produce0/one-third/two-thirds/one; equality fails. Route the remaining satellite budget to SPY. This reuses fixed relative-momentum horizons and voting logic with an equity benchmark,not the old gold/BIL target or a fitted share.
methodology.controlled_targets: Both candidates start from the published graded-gold half-equity-breadth desired targets. Keep MTUM/VLUE/QUAL/USMV,GLD,BIL and every other original target exactly. Only SOXX/SPY may change; preserve combined SOXX+SPY budget and total98%investment. Do not recompute equity/gold risk balance for the switched composition or renormalize styles. Unchanged budget is not an equal-risk or equal-dollar-holding guarantee.
methodology.execution: Feed each switched monthly desired target into the unmodified prior observed-weight execution adapter with its original2.5ppactualclosingweight band. Its original pure-band execution candidate handle selects the shared rule,not a claim to replay that old strategy's inputs or positions. Recompute actual positions/fees/band decisions independently for every cost/window after publication;initialUSD10000deployment forced,dated1/2session requests not overwritten,cost5/20bp andUSD1/order unchanged.
methodology.source: SOXX and SPY use the original audited12-asset price/risk-free snapshot. No new quotes,synthetic history,current constituent data,leverage or additional funds. Sector-signal/unused-portfolio XLK versions and eight-core/rawCSV guards remain. The four actual style exposures and original gold-relative rule are retained; this is an existing-momentum equity construction,not a new family.
methodology.selection: Exactly two fixed hypotheses after142exposed-history configurations. The half-source was chosen after observed prior outcomes and is not an independent holdout. No winner horizon,vote weights,threshold,sector subset,band,fees or portfolio shares fitted after new results. Preserve every failed path;prior selection diagnostics do not correct these trials or the complete search.
methodology.goals: All exact10y/5ybase/stress paths independently startUSD10000withdeployment. Net excessSharpe strictly>1,CAGR>same-costSPY,stressCAGR>basecostSPY anddrawdown<=15%jointly required. Historical qualification still needs independent actual forward evidence;W42plans/IJRPKWquota and both frozen forward models remain.
